summary.text: Human motion generation models are fundamentally constrained by the limited diversity of motion capture datasets, and predictors often overlook adherence to physical and logical constraints for multimodal predictions. A VQ-VAE learns shape-aware motion primitives or tokenizes motion to capture spatiotemporal patterns and discrete intention queries, which supports topology-aware forecasting frameworks and generative modeling for motion generation and prediction.

target_user.text: Academic researchers and entities working on collaborative caching and multi-edge systems with robust federated deep learning.

jtbd.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: To forecast human motion trajectories and generate realistic sequences while adhering to physical constraints and topological lane structures.

value_prop.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: Expanding the motion representation space via VQ-VAE tokenization enables models to capture richer motion primitives and improve prediction feasibility and diversity.

riskiest_assumption.text: Given the viability score of 1.0 (lowest) from dvf:19, the riskiest assumption is that customers will pay for a VQ-VAE-based motion generation and prediction system.

mvp.text: Conduct customer interviews and a price acceptance test to evaluate willingness to pay for VQ-VAE-based motion generation and prediction capabilities, addressing the low viability score in dvf:19.
mvp.type: customer interviews and price acceptance test

success_metric.text: Proposed threshold: at least 40 percent of interviewed target users express willingness to pay for the system during price acceptance testing.

kill_criteria.text: Proposed threshold: fewer than 10 percent of interviewed users confirm a willingness to pay for the proposed solution during the MVP test.

open_source.use: Provides vector quantization modules in PyTorch to tokenize motion and learn discrete codebooks.
Efficient similarity search and clustering for handling large vector representations in codebooks.

to_build.text: A topology-aware intention selector and custom decoder for mapping discrete VQ-VAE motion tokens to feasible motion generation trajectories.
